slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙

翌日，古道圣地某处平台上。
由于三圣试炼的地点，位于一处名为虚界的次空间之中。
所以在开始之前，需要参与者先聚集在此，并在领队的带领下通过传送阵进入。
作为五十年才开放一次的活动，历届三圣试炼，都颇受圣地重视。
这一天很早，所有报名参加三圣试炼的外门弟子，全部都已经在这里聚集完毕了。
而当见到人群中的叶云，周围不少认识他的弟子都吃了一惊。
“稀奇了，叶云这老家伙，居然也敢来参加三圣试炼？”
“他不会以为，这三圣试炼和外门考核一样吧？”
“啧啧，估计他是没法活着出来了。”
“……”
对于这次外门考核，唯一一个通过的杂役弟子。
叶云在外门之中，稍微还是有一点辨识度，不少人都听说过他，知道他利用法宝战胜过一位凝气五重的外门弟子。
然而这份实力，在他们乃至三圣试炼中就完全不够看了……
对于他们的议论，叶云尽管听在耳中，却并未在意。
“果然，来的都是些外门的精锐……”
叶云混在人群之中，也在打量着周围的外门弟子。
大概看下来，总共有一百人左右，其中凝气十重及以下就占了九成以上。
至于凝气十一重，乃至更高的弟子，数量上加一起连十个都没有。
而和他一样在凝气巅峰的弟子，更是只有两个，看起来也都年纪不小了。

归其原因也很简单，年轻点的达到这个境界，大多都有信心突破先天之境，故而不会想冒险参与三圣试炼。
“如果其它圣地也这样，那就没什么问题了。”
叶云松了口气，心中暗暗思索着。
可忽然之间，他皱起眉头，就在刚刚分明感受到，有三道冷厉的气息锁定自己。
他余光扫了眼周围，很快在人群之中，注意到两男一女三名弟子。
明明自己都不认识他们，但这三人对他展现出的敌意，简直是扑面而来，实在有些不太对劲。
“难不成……又是陈天傲？”
这三人的气息都不弱，尽管和自己还有些差距，但还是小心一些比较好。
就在他思索之时，周围一位化丹境长老朗声道。
“都先安静。”
此话一出，周围迅速安静下来，所有人都好奇看向他。
接着，就见那长老抬起手来，掌心飞出一道道金色的流光，精准的落在每一个人的手中。

The next day, on a platform somewhere in the ancient holy land.
Because the location of the Trial of the Three Saints is located in a sub-space called the virtual world.
Therefore, before starting, participants need to gather here and enter through the teleportation array under the leadership of the team leader.
As an event that is only open once in fifty years, all previous Trials of the Three Saints are highly valued by the Holy Land.
It was very early that day, and all the outer disciples who had signed up to participate in the Three Saints Trial had already gathered here.
When they saw Ye Yun in the crowd, many of the disciples who knew him were surprised.
"It's strange that this old guy Ye Yun actually dares to participate in the Three Saints Trial?"
"He doesn't think that these three holy trials are the same as the outer sect examinations, does he?"
"Tsk, tsk, I guess he won't make it out alive."
"..."
For this outer sect examination, he was the only handyman disciple who passed.
Ye Yun is still somewhat recognizable among the outer sects. Many people have heard of him and know that he used magic weapons to defeat an outer sect disciple at the fifth level of Qi Condensation.
However, this strength is completely insufficient for them and even the Trials of the Three Saints...
Although Ye Yun heard their discussion, he didn't pay much attention to it.
"As expected, those who came are all elites from the outer sect..."
Ye Yun mingled among the crowd and was also looking at the outer disciples around him.
From a rough look, there were about a hundred people in total, and more than 90% of them were at the tenth level of Qi Condensation and below.
As for the disciples at the eleventh level of Qi Condensation or even higher, there are not even ten disciples in total.
And there are only two disciples who are at the same peak of Qi Condensation as him, and they all look to be quite old.
The reason is also very simple. Most of those who reach this realm at a younger age have the confidence to break through the innate realm, so they do not want to risk participating in the Trials of the Three Saints.
"If other holy places are like this, then there will be no problem."
Ye Yun breathed a sigh of relief and thought secretly in his heart.
But suddenly, he frowned, and just now he clearly felt that there were three cold and stern auras locking on him.
He glanced around with his peripheral vision, and soon noticed three disciples, two men and one woman, among the crowd.
Even though he didn't even know them, the hostility shown by these three people towards him was so overwhelming that something really wasn't right.
"Could it be...that it's Chen Tianao again?"
The auras of these three people are not weak. Although there is still a gap between them and myself, it is better to be careful.
Just as he was thinking about it, an elder from the Alchemy Realm around him spoke loudly.
"Everyone be quiet first."
As soon as these words came out, the surrounding area quickly became quiet, and everyone looked at him curiously.
Then, the elder raised his hand, and streams of golden light flew out of his palm, falling accurately into everyone's hands.
